description.p: Slive is a lightweight and user-friendly application for watching live streams across multiple platforms, offering a seamless watching experience with support for popular streaming services.
Slive 是一款轻量级且用户友好的直播观看应用，支持多个主流直播平台，提供流畅的观看体验。
